description: Defines a template class 'executor_metrics_decorator' that wraps a task executor to track performance metrics such as latency, resource usage, and execution counts. It manages a pool of tasks, handles execution and deferral, and reports metrics via a channel. Includes tracing and logging support.

classes.name: executor_metrics_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for task executors that tracks performance metrics, manages task pooling, and reports metrics.

methods.name: executor_metrics_decorator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decorator with executor, metrics channel, tracer, and name.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a task, tracking enqueue time and managing task pooling.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Defers a task, tracking enqueue time and managing task pooling.

methods.name: run_task
methods.description: Runs a task, measures execution and resource usage, then calls handle_metrics.

methods.name: handle_metrics
methods.description: Calculates and reports execution metrics, including latency and resource usage, and handles tracing.
